task_spec.text: Find the reaction on the Postgres 16 migration announcement in #core-infra that was left by a member of #project-alpha-dev.
Post a reply in #core-infra thanking that person by name for confirming they're ready for the downtime.

access_plan: Use conversations.history on #core-infra to locate the Postgres migration announcement, then reactions.get on that message to enumerate its reactions and reacting user IDs. For each reacting user, check conversations.members on #project-alpha-dev (or users.conversations for that user) to confirm membership, isolating the single qualifying reaction. Then use chat.postMessage with thread_ts set to the announcement's ts to post the thank-you reply naming that user.
